column2: I think men definitely would [home]-test . . . because there is no place like home. It is where I know I can get all the support . [DiCarlo, p. 877] Yeah, like none sees me while I test. And once I am done, I throw it to the dustbin. (Man, age 26) [Jennings, p. 5] ...they should make these hospitals operate 24 hours because this one is a big hospital.... The reason why I'm saying that is because there are some people who work in daytime up to very late and when they come here they don't get services because the doctors and the nurses are gone. (Man with HIV, age 40) [Okal, p. 14]

Home testing allows for a comfortable, private environment for testing and is enhanced by health counsellors. Self-testing gives men a sense of control, privacy and convenience. Flexible facility hours help to accommodate busy work schedules.
